name: Bumble
description: Bumble is a dating app. Bottom nav, left to right: Profile, Discover, People (the swipe deck, where Bumble usually opens), Liked You (paid Beeline), Chats. All messaging lives on Chats: a 'Your matches' row of round avatars (new matches, each ringed in yellow as its time runs down) above the conversation list. Either person can message first now -- the Chats list itself says 'We're sunsetting Opening Moves. Now either person can message first, and a reply opens the chat.' -- but a new match's chat takes ONE message until the other person replies. On this phone Bumble often freezes and Android shows 'Bumble isn't responding'; tap 'Wait'.

workflows.name: open_chats
workflows.steps: open_app com.bumble.app. It usually lands on People, the swipe deck: the element list shows the profile card scroller (id=encountersGridProfile_list), or, when the deck is empty, 'You've seen everyone nearby' with an 'Adjust your filters' button. Touch nothing there. Tap 'Chats' in the bottom nav -- the rightmost tab, listed as [Button] 'Chats Chats' (it becomes plain [Text] 'Chats' once selected). The Chats screen reads, top to bottom: the title 'Chats' with a 'Search' icon; 'Your matches' (id=connections_expiringConnectionsTitle) above one [Button] '<name>, Date, match' per new match (id=connectionItem_ringView); a 'Chats' header with 'Recent' and the filter icon 'Conversations are filtered by Recent'; sometimes a promo card; then one [Button] per conversation (id=connectionItem) labelled '<name>, Date, match <name> <last message>', with 'Your move' before the last message when the match wrote last; then 'Older chats (N)'.

workflows.name: send_opener_to_new_match
workflows.steps: Tap a '<name>, Date, match' avatar under 'Your matches'. The chat (activity .chat.conversation.ConversationActivity) opens on an empty state: their photo, '<name>, <age>' (id=profileInfo_name), '<N> hours left to message', and a tip card 'You get one message to start' / 'Try making it personal, ask about their:' with topic chips such as 'Hidden talents', 'Pet-peeves', 'Next availability'. No [Button] id=message_bubble anywhere means nobody has written yet (an empty chat). The input row at the bottom holds 'Camera' (id=chatInput_button_attach), the text field [Input] 'Aa' (id=chatInput_text -- 'Aa' is its placeholder, not a draft), 'GIF', an unlabelled video-message button (id=chatInput_button_right_extra_tertiary_action) and 'Voice message' (the mic). Type into the 'Aa' field with input_text with confidence='low', verify the text on the next turn from the screenshot, then tap [Button] 'Send message' (id=chatInput_button_send): it takes the mic's place at the right end of the input row once the field has focus, and stays disabled until the field holds text. Never tap topic chips, GIF, Camera, voice/video call, or options. Then tap 'Back' chevron (top-left) to return to Chats.

workflows.name: read_and_reply_in_conversation
workflows.steps: On Chats list, a row marked 'Your move' is a conversation where the newest message was sent by the match. Rows without 'Your move' end in your own message; expired rows read 'Conversation expired'. Tap a 'Your move' row (id=connectionItem) to open. Messages are [Button] id=message_bubble, listed oldest at top, newest at bottom: yellow bubbles on right (@top-right) are yours; grey bubbles on left (@top-left) are the match's. 'Today' / 'Yesterday' (id=timestamp_text) are date dividers, and 'Delivered' / 'Read' (id=status_text) under your bubble is delivery status -- neither is a message. If the newest bubble is yours, send nothing. If replying per policy, type into 'Aa' with confidence='low', verify text in screenshot, tap 'Send message'. Leftover drafts: Bumble preserves unsent drafts in 'Aa' across restarts; if leaving without sending, clear 'Aa' with empty input_text. Leave with 'Back' chevron at top-left, returning to Chats.

workflows.name: handle_not_responding
workflows.steps: Android's 'Bumble isn't responding' dialog (package android: [Text] id=alertTitle, [Button] 'Close app' id=aerr_close, [Button] 'Wait' id=aerr_wait) comes up often on this phone -- when a chat opens or closes, or when Bumble loses focus to another app. Tap 'Wait': Bumble recovers and the screen underneath is as it was. 'Close app' kills Bumble and loses your place (open_app brings it back on People). The dialog can return several times in a row; tap 'Wait' each time.

nuances: The element list renders emoji as '..' (every character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane becomes two dots): a bubble reading 'Hey ..' is 'Hey 🔥', and a row preview 'Same here ..' ends in an emoji. Read emoji off the screenshot, never off the element list.
Chat screens are FLAG_SECURE, so a plain adb screencap of one is black; adbagent recovers the frame from the emulator host window automatically.
Bumble keeps unsent text in the 'Aa' field across app restarts: a draft typed and never sent is still sitting there the next time that chat opens.
'You get one message to start' means exactly that: a new match's chat takes one message from you, and the chat opens properly once they reply.

The People tab is the swipe deck. A horizontal swipe on a card likes or passes that profile, and cannot be undone. Its cards carry 'Send a compliment' (paid), 'Send SuperSwipe' (paid, id=profile_details_badgeSuperSwipe) and 'Recommend to a friend' (shares the profile). The main pager (id=mainApp_viewPager) scrolls horizontally too, so never swipe sideways anywhere in Bumble; change tabs with the bottom nav.
Liked You (Beeline) is paywalled and Discover is another profile-browsing surface; neither has anything to do with messaging.
An expired conversation reads 'Conversation expired N days ago', with 'Expired match' in its row label and a grey ring. Reviving one is paid (Rematch / Extend).
The 'Your move' badge (id=connectionItem_badge) sits at the right of a row whose newest message is the match's. A row without it ends in your own message.
In a new match's chat the toolbar's 'Voice call' and 'Video call' are disabled; in an open conversation they are live. 'Options' (three dots, top-right) holds unmatch and report.
The conversation list is sorted by 'Recent' (filter icon 'Conversations are filtered by Recent'), so a conversation with a new message moves to the top; 'Older chats (N)' is collapsed history.

A promo card can sit at the top of the conversation list (observed: 'We're sunsetting Opening Moves. Now either person can message first, and a reply opens the chat.', id=connections_chatStickyPromoEntryPoint). It is not a conversation.
Opening a chat can show a blank white screen with a yellow loading spinner for a second or two before the messages draw; wait for it rather than tapping.
recommendations: Every pass: open_app com.bumble.app, tap 'Chats' in the bottom nav straight away, and work only on the Chats screen and the chats it opens.
Decide what to open from the 'Your matches' row and the 'Your move' badge; skip rows without 'Your move' and expired rows.
Before sending, read who wrote the newest bubble off the screenshot (yellow on the right = yours, grey on the left = theirs), and read emoji off the screenshot too.
Return to the Chats list with the 'Back' chevron after each chat, and end the pass there.
On 'Bumble isn't responding', tap 'Wait' -- never 'Close app'.
